name: Member Of Group
description: This OS account is a member of this OS group on the same host, so it holds whatever the host grants the group (wheel, sudo, docker, Administrators). A reference, not containment: removing a group ends the membership edge and leaves the account. Both ends are local to one host; a domain group nested in a local Windows group is a directory principal and is not modelled here.

primary.description: True when the membership comes from the account's own primary-group field (the gid column of a POSIX /etc/passwd entry), which the group's member list does not repeat. False when the group lists the account as a member (/etc/group, a Windows local group's member list). Absent means the source did not say which.
